_comment: Wrong answers for the 70 quiz questions in the revised course plan.
The plan supplies each question, its correct answer and why it matters, but
not the options a child chooses between. Its own release checklist asks:
'Does each wrong answer reveal a real misconception?' — so these are written
against the misconceptions each lesson exists to correct, not as filler.
AUTHORED, NOT PARSED. A qualified tutor must review this file before
